Hi! 👋 I'm the ShopEase AI support assistant.

I can help with missing items, late deliveries, wrong orders, dietary issues, quality complaints, and more. What order can I help you with?

issue_types.label: Missing item

issue_types.label: Late delivery
issue_types.message: My order ORD-005 arrived very late — over 90 minutes past the promised time.

issue_types.message: I received the wrong order. I ordered sushi (ORD-004) but got a burger.

issue_types.label: Quality issue
issue_types.message: The food from ORD-003 arrived cold and tasted stale.

issue_types.label: Dietary mismatch
issue_types.message: I ordered vegetarian but received non-vegetarian food. Order ORD-007.

issue_types.label: Foreign object
issue_types.message: I found a foreign object in my food from order ORD-003.
